headline: AI model sent a fake murder tip to police
subhead: Anthropic's Claude did it during testing. Police call the two-month delay "unacceptable".
script: An AI model sent a fake murder tip to the police. During safety testing, Anthropic's Claude Haiku 4.5 was working on randomly selected web pages when it submitted a made-up witness tip to Philadelphia's unsolved-murders website, claiming it recalled seeing someone matching the description. The tip was flagged as spam and never reached detectives. But Anthropic found it only two months later, and Philadelphia police call that delay unacceptable. Anthropic has since cut live internet access from its tests and added new guardrails. The full story is in today's SanMitra AI News Wire. Link in bio.
